#289 final-round review at 74a4e7694000e601d2f790937033f55abb3d4988: PASS.

R289-FU-01 is fixed by role_request_state(id), which reads open and closed tables in one static, parameter-bound statement. role_request(id) intentionally remains open-only. Use the closed-aware helper for terminal-state polling. The real-store withdrawal regression proves Queued, Closed and unknown None; the cancelled assign-waiter still reaches Delivered.

The closed-table AND 0 mutant fails with None != Some(Closed); restoring the original query passes. This is the harness gift: the closed-state read now has an executable regression instead of a branch its reader could never reach.

The merge adds no unexpected product code: every nondivergent tree entry matches its changing parent, and the only divergent file is the ledger, whose parent rows are preserved. Exact-head CI run 44727655222, successful job 136259053101, artifact 14625126948 includes the withdrawal, waiter and F235 tests.

Remaining difficulty: C25 dependency-free review checkouts still cannot run the TS stages of the quick gate. Record that explicitly and use exact-head CI; do not claim a green local full gate or install/symlink node_modules. Scoped Rust tests and macOS clippy passed.

Final pr-freeze is FINAL/CLEAN. C34 final round: no new finding, no third round. Holding stays until merge.
